# CacheLane — local cache-discipline layer for Claude Code

> A local MCP server and Claude Code hooks that reorganize prompts so Anthropic's cache fires more often, delivering 30%-60% lower input-token cost on long sessions.

CacheLane is a local MCP server plus Claude Code hooks (PreRequest/PostResponse) that sits between Claude Code and api.anthropic.com to cut input-token cost on every turn, targeting 30%-60% lower input-token cost on long sessions with no change to how the user drives Claude Code.
